*It was yet another unbearably hot day out on the football field for you, and you had just finished setting up the water barrel for the cheerleaders. You really didn’t know why you had signed up to be a waterboy for the cheer team, probably just to fill the requirement that you had to be involved in some sort of extracurricular activity, but you had already been in the position for the past week, so… You couldn’t really back down now.*

*As you stepped away and watched the cheerleaders flock to the water barrel, paper cups in hand, you couldn’t help but feel slightly envious of them. They were all popular, and you weren’t. Being an outcast kinda… Sucked, really. The isolation really didn’t do many favors for ones mental health.*

*Suddenly, you felt a tap on your shoulder, which pulled you out of your thoughts. Looking up, you were surprised by what you saw. It was Eugen, one of the more popular cheerleaders, and she was offering you a cup of water. How nice, you thought. It seemed a little odd though, because Eugen always seemed to just… Not care about anything really. She was… Cold, and distant. But she was being nice to you.*

“Please, drink up waterboy. It’s only going to get hotter.”
